column1: # The APIs the game's code calls that the hand-written layer (recomp/src/cs, recomp/src/bind on recomp/src/unity)
# doesn't bind yet (tools/translate survey; bindings in tools/translate/bindings.tsv). Each blocks the methods
# that call it from translating: `methods` and `lines` (their C# lines; a method missing several APIs counts
# for each) over the counted classes (progress/classes.tsv). Sorted by lines blocked.
# kind: type (a type with no C++ mapping), get/set (a property), call, new (a constructor), op (an operator or
#   conversion), field, add/remove (an event), delegate (a method used as a delegate), base (a base constructor).
